1. Acceptance

These Terms govern access to and use of AACP™ Career Navigator.

All users must register an account, accept these Terms of Use and obtain parental or guardian authorization where required.

2. Platform Purpose

Career Navigator provides educational resources, career exploration, career intelligence and personalized education planning.

The platform supports informed career decisions but does not replace professional, academic or regulatory advice.

3. Account Eligibility and Security

Career Navigator applies a privacy-by-design registration model. Students are not required to provide their real names or exact dates of birth.

Users must:

  • Provide accurate required registration information.
  • Protect their account credentials.
  • Comply with applicable age and authorization requirements.
  • Report suspected unauthorized account access.

Users must not access another person's account without authorization.

4. Acceptable Use

Career Navigator must be used for lawful and appropriate educational and career development purposes.

Prohibited activities include:

  • Unauthorized access to accounts or personal information.
  • Harassment, discrimination or abusive conduct.
  • Malicious activity or interference with platform operations.
  • Circumvention of privacy, consent or security safeguards.
  • Unauthorized extraction, reproduction or commercial redistribution of platform content.

5. ACIA™ Career Intelligence

ACIA™ provides career-focused guidance using verified information and controlled AI-assisted services.

ACIA™ operates through a dedicated privacy and responsible AI gateway hosted in Canada.

Student messages, conversation histories and account identifiers are not transmitted to external AI providers.

Supplementary AI-generated guidance is obtained through controlled, non-identifying requests and is subject to privacy, safety and content validation.

ACIA™ may restrict requests outside its educational scope.

Users should verify important academic, training, licensing and employment requirements with relevant institutions and regulatory authorities.

ACIA™ does not guarantee admission, certification, scholarships, employment or specific career outcomes.

6. Student Safety

ACIA™ incorporates age-appropriate privacy and safety safeguards.

ACIA™ is not a mental health counselling, emergency response or actively monitored crisis service.

Users requiring urgent assistance should contact appropriate support services, trusted adults or emergency responders.

7. Student Sharing Permissions

Students control who can access their career plans.

Authorized recipients receive view-only access and must respect student privacy.

Students may revoke access at any time, with immediate effect.

Sharing and revocation activities are recorded for accountability.

Subscription sponsorship does not automatically grant access to student information.

8. Subscriptions and Payments

Career Navigator is a commercial platform offering free and paid subscription features.

Current individual pricing:

SubscriptionPrice (CAD)
Free registered account$0.00
Student Premium — School year$49.99
Student Premium — Advisor-invited$7.99/month

Payments are processed through Stripe.

Parents, guardians and institutions may sponsor student access without automatically receiving access to student career plans.

Applicable taxes, subscription periods, renewal arrangements, cancellation procedures and refund conditions will be disclosed before purchase.

Purchases requiring parental or guardian authorization must receive the applicable approval.

Institutional licensing and classroom access may be governed by separate commercial agreements.

9. Account Deletion

Users may delete their accounts directly through Career Navigator.

Personal information associated with the active account is erased upon deletion, and a confirmation email is issued.

Information subject to applicable legal, financial or documented retention requirements may be retained as described in the Privacy Policy.

Users will be informed of any subscription cancellation requirements associated with account deletion.

10. Intellectual Property

AACP™, ACIA™, Career Navigator and associated proprietary technology, branding, content and educational materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners or authorized licensors.

Users receive a limited, non-exclusive and non-transferable right to access Career Navigator for authorized educational and career development purposes.

Unauthorized copying, reproduction, commercial redistribution or reverse engineering is prohibited, except where permitted by applicable law.

Users retain applicable rights in their original submitted content.

11. Institutional Use

School, school board and other institutional access may be governed by separate licensing, privacy and service agreements.

Institutional participation does not automatically grant access to individual student information.

Institutional users must comply with applicable privacy requirements and approved access permissions.

12. Service Availability

AACP™ may update, maintain or modify Career Navigator to improve functionality, privacy, security and educational value.

Access may be restricted where reasonably necessary to address security concerns, unauthorized activity or material violations of these Terms.

13. Limitations and Disclaimer

Career Navigator is an educational and advisory resource.

Career information, educational requirements, training costs, salary information and employment conditions may change over time.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, AACP™ is not responsible for decisions made solely in reliance on platform guidance.

Nothing in these Terms excludes mandatory statutory rights or consumer protections.

14. Privacy and Data Protection

Personal information is handled in accordance with the Career Navigator Privacy Policy and applicable privacy legislation.

Consent records and ACIA™ processing are hosted in Canada. Other account data is stored with service providers as described in the Privacy Policy.

Student consent, parental or guardian authorization and access permissions are managed according to applicable platform and institutional requirements.

15. Changes to Terms

AACP™ may update these Terms to reflect changes in platform functionality, legal requirements or commercial arrangements.

Users will be notified of material changes.

Renewed acceptance may be required before continued access to applicable features.

16. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the applicable laws of Alberta and Canada, subject to mandatory consumer protection and other applicable legal requirements.
